subject.title: Control UI: Model provider display shows original config value instead of normalized value (e.g., 'bailian' vs 'zai')

question: Should derived Control UI Usage/Sessions provider display and aggregate surfaces canonicalize provider aliases, and if so should users see only the canonical provider ID or both the configured alias and canonical ID?
rationale: The code defect is source-reproducible, but changing display, filters, CSV, and aggregate keys crosses provider/config compatibility boundaries and may alter user-visible grouping semantics.

options.title: Canonicalize derived surfaces
options.body: Normalize display, filter, query, CSV, and aggregate keys through the existing model/manifest provider-alias contract while preserving raw persisted fields.

options.title: Show alias plus canonical
options.body: Display values like alias (canonical) to reduce confusion while avoiding a silent replacement of the user's configured provider text.

options.title: Keep raw provider display
options.body: Treat raw configured provider text as the intended UI contract and close or retitle the remaining work around docs or model-picker-only behavior.

recommendation.title: Canonicalize derived surfaces
recommendation.body: Normalize display, filter, query, CSV, and aggregate keys through the existing model/manifest provider-alias contract while preserving raw persisted fields.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and recent history put the active provider normalizer and Usage UI/API paths under Vincent Koc's recent work, making this the best available routing owner for the contract decision.
